utilities.name: SurveyGen

paper.title: SurveyGen: Quality-Aware Scientific Survey Generation with Large Language Models

utilities.what: Retrieve, outline and write a scientific survey, then score the draft for reference quality before a human reads it.
checklist: freeze the retrieval date and record every query string
verify each kept reference against its full text, not the abstract
report overlap with the anchor paper's related work, with counts
state what the survey misses before anyone cites it

utilities.name: LLM automated literature review (evaluation)

paper.title: Large Language Models for Automated Literature Review: An Evaluation of Reference Generation, Abstract Writing, and Review Composition

utilities.what: An evaluation protocol for LLM-generated reviews: check reference existence, abstract fidelity and review composition separately.
checklist: score reference existence separately from writing quality
count fabricated or mismatched references explicitly
do not let a fluent review hide a bad reference list

utilities.name: Multi-agent limitation generation

paper.title: Multi-Agent LLMs for Generating Research Limitations

utilities.what: Split limitation finding across extractor, analyzer, reviewer and judge roles so each gap is argued and then checked.
checklist: quote the passage that supports each gap
keep the extractor and the judge separate
report coverage: which sections were read
one paragraph of problem definition, not a wish list

utilities.name: Can LLMs identify critical limitations?

paper.title: Can LLMs Identify Critical Limitations within Scientific Research? A Systematic Evaluation on AI Research Papers

utilities.what: A benchmark and taxonomy for judging whether a model's limitation list is specific, evidence-backed and non-obvious.
checklist: classify each gap against the taxonomy before ranking
drop generic gaps ("more datasets needed") unless evidenced
mark anything the authors already acknowledge

utilities.name: BAGELS

paper.title: BAGELS: Benchmarking the Automated Generation and Extraction of Limitations from Scholarly Text

utilities.what: Benchmark for extracting stated limitations from papers, useful as a sanity check that a gap is author-stated rather than invented.
checklist: separate stated limitations from inferred ones
keep the extraction spans so a human can check them
never present an inferred gap as author-stated

utilities.name: HypER

paper.title: HypER: Literature-grounded Hypothesis Generation and Distillation with Provenance

utilities.what: Generate hypotheses grounded in retrieved literature and keep the provenance chain from paper to claim to hypothesis.
checklist: attach at least one verified source to each hypothesis
separate the hypothesis from the method that would test it
flag ideas whose only support is another LLM output

utilities.name: ResearchAgent

paper.title: ResearchAgent: Iterative Research Idea Generation over Scientific Literature with Large Language Models

utilities.what: Generate, review and refine research ideas over a literature context with reviewing agents scoring novelty, feasibility, clarity and impact.
checklist: fix the rubric and the number of reviewer rounds before generating
keep every idea, including the rejected ones, with its scores
record why the chosen idea was chosen, not only its rank
check that each idea names a dataset, metric and baseline

utilities.name: HypoEvolve

paper.title: HypoEvolve: Genetic Algorithms Enable Multi-Agent LLMs to Discover Scientific Hypotheses

utilities.what: Evolve a population of hypotheses with mutation and selection instead of a single chain of suggestions.
checklist: log the lineage of every surviving hypothesis
keep the fitness function fixed across generations
report the best seed as well as the evolved result

utilities.name: DeepScientist

paper.title: DeepScientist: Advancing Frontier-Pushing Scientific Findings Progressively

utilities.what: Treat discovery as Bayesian optimisation over a memory of findings, so each experiment is chosen against what is already known.
checklist: record negative findings too; they are what stops repeats
state the expected information gain before spending compute
keep the memory in the repo, not in a chat

utilities.name: Arbor

paper.title: Toward Generalist Autonomous Research via Hypothesis-Tree Refinement

utilities.what: A long-lived coordinator with short-lived executors refines a tree of hypotheses and accepts a change only if it also holds on held-out data.
checklist: protect the held-out split before the search starts
review each proposed change before it runs
compare against the strongest simple baseline, not the seed
keep the rejected branches; they are the audit trail

utilities.name: AutoSOTA

paper.title: AutoSOTA: An End-to-End Automated Research System for State-of-the-Art AI Model Discovery

utilities.what: An end-to-end loop that proposes, implements and evaluates model changes against a fixed benchmark.
checklist: pin the benchmark version and the split
report the baseline you actually reproduced, not the paper's number
keep failed candidates in the log

utilities.name: EvoScientist

paper.title: EvoScientist: Towards Multi-Agent Evolving AI Scientists for End-to-End Scientific Discovery

utilities.what: Multi-agent system that evolves its own research strategy across ideation, experimentation and writing.
checklist: keep the evaluation signal out of the agents' reach
record which strategy changed and why
separate gains from the strategy from gains from more compute
